[SWS_CM_00232] Behavior of a ServiceProxy over a secure channel using an
unreliable transport protocol before the secure channel is established
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00804
⌈
The future returned by any
ServiceProxy
method shall only be satisfied after the
configured secure channel is established. The middleware shall drop all received re-
quests if the configured secure channel is not established.
⌋
